title: Set the system date and time
summary: Manually set the system clock to a specific date and time. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Set the system date and time using the format MMDDhhmmYYYY.ss. Note that YYYY and .ss are optional.
steps.expect: The system clock is updated to the specified time.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to revert to the previous time. Re-enable automatic time synchronization (e.g., via NTP or systemd-timesyncd) to correct the clock.

warnings: Manually setting the system time can break applications that rely on accurate timestamps, such as SSL/TLS verification, cron jobs, and logging systems.
Ensure you have the correct format (MMDDhhmmYYYY) to avoid setting an invalid date.
